segments.text: I've tried a lot of crazy therapies and most of them didn't even work. But this one did. This is hyperbaric oxygen therapy or HBOT. It delivers 100% oxygen that you breathe inside this pressurized chamber. That pressurization pushes the oxygen deep into the body, boosting repair and recovery. After 60 sessions of HBOT, we saw the most impressive results we've seen from any therapy to date. It wiped out inflammation in my body, improved a marker for blood vessel growth by 300%. Decreased a marker for

dementia, drastically improved my gut and skin health, and even lengthened my tails, a key marker tied to slower biological aging. My protocol was simple. Five sessions per week, 90 minutes per session, two atmospheres of pressure, cycling 20 minutes of 100% oxygen with 5minute breaks in between.

You're probably thinking, "Un, that looks expensive as." But guess what? Yeah. No, you're right. It is. My goal in this is to share information on therapies that actually work.
